messages:
jordan: Heads-up — I'm drafting a fallback matrix for authz routing when project keys fail (quota, revoked, missing). TL;DR proposal: prefer project key -> service account -> org key, but with nuanced exceptions for billing and admin flows. Thoughts?

maya: I like the baseline. key thing: we need clear telemetry fields so we can attribute cost/latency to fallbacks. propose: auth.effective_key_type, auth.fallback_reason, auth.orig_key_id (hashed). metric: auth.fallback.count and auth.fallback.latency_p50/p95. :eyes:

ethan: agree. also UX: console should show a small badge next to requests/route history like "Used ORG KEY (fallback: quota)" with a link to the auth-fallback dashboard. avoid showing raw key ids.

maya: here's a minimal policy sketch we can use in the routing layer (pseudo-JSON):
```
{
  "fallback_policy": [
    {"when": "quota_exceeded", "try": ["service_account", "org_key"], "metric": "auth.fallback.quota"},
    {"when": "revoked", "try": ["service_account"], "metric": "auth.fallback.revoked"},
    {"when": "missing_project", "try": ["org_key"], "metric": "auth.fallback.missing_project"}
  ]
}
```

jordan: That looks good. A couple of edge cases: 1) billing-sensitive routes must never fall back to org_key unless flagged; 2) admin APIs should prefer SA even if project key exists. We should encode both as route annotations.

ethan: For rollout, I suggest a canary flag auth_fallback_v2 that we gate by route and by tenant. Start with 5% overall and specific non-billing tenants. capture full traceId + hash(orig_key_id) for sampling.

ops: @jordan can you add the console badge spec? ops needs the copy to wire the tooltip and dashboard link. Also we need a migration plan for customers that expect org_key billing attribution.

jordan: will do. Draft badge text: "Used ORG KEY — fallback (quota)" with hover: "Request used org-level key due to project quota. View details -> /dashboards/auth-fallback?tenant=<tid>&trace=<trace>". Need to confirm redaction policy.

maya: Redaction: store hashed_orig_key_id and unhashed effective_key_id only for org-admin dashboards under RBAC. For telemetry metrics we only increment counters, no raw ids. For debugging we allow ephemeral logs (retention 7d) with full ids behind SRE access.

ethan: sounds reasonable. SRE: are you OK with 7d ephemeral logs behind SRE RBAC? @sre-bot

sre-bot: canary flag auth_fallback_v2 created, will route 5% traffic in staging. ephemeral debug logs enabled for that canary (7d retention). :white_check_mark:

ops: we also need alerting: new alert "auth.fallback.rate > 1% for billing routes". Ops will own it.

jordan: agreed. next steps: 1) implement fallback_policy proto in routing code, 2) add telemetry fields + metrics, 3) console badge + dashboard link, 4) canary rollout (5% -> 25% -> 100%). I'll open PRs and a canary playbook. :pray:

maya: please include a shortship checklist: metrics dashboards, alert, sampling logs, RBAC gate, UX copy. I'll review the PR.

ethan: +1. labeling: pkg/auth/router/fallback_v2.go and console: web/ui/src/components/AuthBadge.jsx.

jordan: thanks all — I'll post links to PRs and the canary playbook here when ready.

sre-bot: canary deployed to staging at 7478539300 (5% traffic).

ops: copying the dashboard ticket here: https://internal.redwood/dashboards/boards/123 (for ops wiring).
